gary_2026_10_21_humanity_in_the_room_ai_.title: Humanity In The Room: AI For Good Walk
gary_2026_10_21_humanity_in_the_room_ai_.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_21_humanity_in_the_room_ai_.summary: Gary's Guide: There are a ton of conversations that we have been having lately, that have come up from UNGA & NY Climate Week: AI & the third wave of philanthropy money, AI & it's affects on climate, & evaluations for AI systems (especially with x-risks!). Please join us in a walk around west side of Manhattan at sunset, stopping to hear from people doing work at this intersection, & using the time in between to talk to each other about what we just heard. The format is simple: we walk, we stop three times for a speaker, & in between each stop we mix up who we're walking with. We don't have our three speakers confirmed yet. Nominate someone you think should be heard, or put yourself forward - have a provocation that we should talk about? We're looking for people doing honest, grounded work, not polished pitches. We're doing this outside because AI lives on our computers, & building for people means remembering what it feels like to be one. Rain location is Pier 57, & also the start/end location to our walk. Humanity in the Room brings together the people who build AI & the people who have lived experiences that know what tools are actually useful in their communities: engineers, AI safety researchers, nonprofit leaders, funders, & social entrepreneurs. We started as a meetup series in New York. Since then we've run eight events & grown to more than 2,000 members. We were co-founded by Angela Ng & Paulina Munoz. Why we rebranded: We used to be AI for Good NYC. We changed the name for two reasons: "AI for Good" is also the name of the UN's ITU program, & we didn't want to be confused with it. We also outgrew: Our work now reaches beyond New York, & beyond community events, into education & consulting for organizations deciding how to use AI. The new name is a play on "human in the loop." Before AI goes into a clinic, a classroom, or a grant portfolio, someone has to be in the room asking who it serves & what happens when it's wrong. That's the conversation we host. Please join us in making this happen.

gary_2026_10_21_building_with_ai_vibe2pi.title: Building with AI: Vibe2Pitch #2 (w/ The AI Collective)
gary_2026_10_21_building_with_ai_vibe2pi.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_21_building_with_ai_vibe2pi.place: University of Connecticut-Stamford Campus, 1 University Pl, Stamford
gary_2026_10_21_building_with_ai_vibe2pi.summary: Gary's Guide: It will be an action-packed evening where multidisciplinary teams pitch solutions to satisfy real-world needs to a captive audience. Built for beginners & experienced builders alike, no AI background required. This edition's theme: Moving to a New City. Stamford is seeing a wave of new residents right now. What problems do they run into - finding housing, meeting people, navigating the city, choosing food, settling in? Your team will select one topic & build something to address it. You are encouraged to vibe-code a platform/service. Teams of 3-6 people will turn a problem into a working prototype & a pitch/presentation. Success depends on more than a working demo - it's judged on problem definition, market research, product design, storytelling, & how well you put AI tools to use, & will be judged by a panel of experienced judges from the industry. Here's how it works: Register on Luma - bring your own team, or register as a free agent & we'll place you on a team. We kicked off with a Meet & Greet orientation on Sept 16, where this edition's theme was announced - teams are free to start building from that day, at their own pace. If you missed the Meet & Greet, no problem - you can still register as a free agent, or reach out to a team asking to join. Oct 5 - Team assignment day for free agents & UConn students. They get placed onto a team on a rolling basis by organizers, as seen on the dashboard at this link https://bwai.web.app/vibe2pitch Registration stays open after this. Build your project with your team - The organizers won't set up the team meetings, that is scheduled by the teams amongst themselves. The building time is this whole window between the day you join a team, to the pitch day. Oct 18 - Confirm your team's attendance. Oct 21 - Pitch day - The main event Here's the schedule for pitch day itself (Oct 21st): 6:00 - 6:30 PM - Registration & open networking. 6:30 - 6:45 PM - Welcome: an introduction to Building with AI & Vibe2Pitch. 6:45 - 8:45 PM - Pitch time 8:45 - 9:00 PM - Awards, results, & wrap-up. Judging Rubric (Each criterion rated 1-5 points) Defines a Real Problem - is the problem genuine, meaningful & clearly understood? Offers Valuable User Benefits - does the solution create clear, tangible value for the user? Shows Strong Advantages Over Current Solutions - is it meaningfully better than what exists today? Delivers a Confidence-Inspiring Presentation - is the pitch clear, credible & persuasive? Demonstrates a Strong Prototype - does the prototype show the core workflow & credible evidence that it works? Don't have a team? Register as a free agent - we'll assign you one starting from October 5th onwards, on a rolling basis. Already have a venture? If it's relevant to the themes of AI & Moving to a New City, you are welcome to pitch! Please note: space at these community events is limited, & we can't always accept everyone who applies. If you're not accepted this time, please keep applying - we'd love to see you at a future event. The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 200,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 100+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. All attendees & organizers at events affiliated with The AI Collective agree to our privacy policy & are subject to our code of conduct.

gary_2026_10_21_ai_builder_nights_pizza_.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_21_ai_builder_nights_pizza_.summary: Gary's Guide: Good pizza. Great conversations. Cool AI projects. Join us at Fabrik in Tribeca for another NYC AI Builder Night, hosted by Vonage! This time, we're keeping things casual. No presentations or workshops. Just a room full of people interested in building with AI, sharing ideas, learning from each other, & making new connections. What's Happening? Pizza & People Grab a slice, meet other AI builders, & find out what people around NYC are experimenting with. AI Demo: Building a Voice Agent Benjamin Aronov from Vonage will kick things off with a quick demo of an AI voice agent built with Vonage & Deepgram. Show & Tell Working on something cool? We'd love to see it! Share an AI app, agent, automation, experiment, or even something that isn't quite working yet. Demos can be informal. No slides required. Open Build & Hangout The rest of the evening is yours. Work on your own project, get feedback, find a collaborator, exchange ideas, or simply hang out & talk AI. Who Should Come? Whether you're a developer shipping AI agents, a founder experimenting with AI products, or someone who's just starting to build, you're welcome. You don't need a finished project or advanced technical skills. We're bringing together people who are curious, creative, & interested in what AI makes possible. Bring your laptop if you want to build. Bring your curiosity either way.

gary_2026_10_21_agentic_video_production.title: Agentic Video Production
gary_2026_10_21_agentic_video_production.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_21_agentic_video_production.summary: Gary's Guide: Agentic Video Production Shots. Editing. Sound. A connected production workflow. AI video models can now produce a striking clip from a single prompt. Turning clips into a scene is harder: the shots have to match, the cut has to hold, the sound has to fit the picture, & someone has to answer for each choice. Agents are starting to drive, & the options keep multiplying. This talk tours them in practice: Claude & Astra calling video models through MCP & gateways such as Token360 the built-in agents in Higgsfield, Magnific, HeyGen, etc... Claude Motion for motion graphics & animation that stays editable Claude blocking scenes in Blender & working inside Unreal Engine Judging a production & driving remediation cycles a finish in DaVinci Resolve It also covers what it takes to make the process repeatable: story bibles, shared references across episodes, clear handoffs, skill development, many retries. Examples come from a vertical series on the Revolutionary War & from open-source multi-agent systems such as FilmAgent & OpenMontage. You'll leave with a grounded sense of what agents can & can't do for video today, & a small test to try on your own work.

jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.title: Jodeci – Jersey City

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
